name: Agha Khan
title: Blockchain & Stablecoin Lead
bio: Agha serves as the Blockchain and Stablecoin Lead for Deloitte's Blockchain & Digital Assets (BDA) Consulting practice within the US. He has 20+ years of experience in banking and capital markets leading enterprise-wide cross functional teams for Tier 1 investment banks, Asset Managers, Pension Funds and Hedge Funds. He has led public and private sector initiatives experimenting with programable tokenized forms of money and securities to enhance operational efficiencies, improve liquidity and reduce cost. In recent years, he has worked extensively with crypto start-ups (DEXs and DeFi companies) on product strategy, client segmentation, and product management. On the institutional side, he has worked with investment banks and centralized crypto exchanges on institutional client strategy, risk & compliance frameworks, operational & enterprise risk assessments, and vendor due diligence evaluations for digital assets.

name: Azeem Khan
title: Co-Founder
bio: Azeem Khan is the cofounder of Miden, a zero-knowledge that raised $25 million in seed funding led by a16z crypto, 1kx, and Hack VC. He serves as a consultant to the UNICEF CryptoFund and is a member of the World Economic Forum’s Crypto Sustainability Coalition. Recognized as a 2x Faces of Crypto Philanthropy by The Giving Block and one of the 100 Faces of Crypto by Stand With Crypto, Azeem is also a contributor with Forbes and a columnist with CoinDesk.

name: Bernie Moreno
title: United States Senator
bio: Bernie Moreno was born in Bogota, Colombia. He moved to the United States with his family at age five and became an American citizen at age 18. Bernie purchased his first car dealership in 2005 and grew that one dealership into one of the largest dealership groups in America, eventually employing over 1,000 Ohioans. More recently, in 2016, Bernie recognized the value and transformational potential of blockchain technology, before it received mainstream attention, and moved much of his volunteer time and investment dollars into the space. In 2024, Bernie Moreno was elected to the United States Senate where he is fighting every day to restore the American Dream and put Ohioans’ needs first. Through his work on the Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs Committee, Bernie is working to ensure that America leads in the future of finance and technology. Drawing on his private-sector experience, he is shaping pro-growth policies for digital assets and cryptocurrency.

name: Bobby Lee
title: Founder & CEO
bio: Bobby Lee is author of the Wall Street Journal bestseller, The Promise of Bitcoin. He is also the Founder and CEO of Ballet, the cryptocurrency company behind the innovative REAL Series cold storage card. Launched in 2019, this self custody card is the world’s first ever non-electronic cold storage with multicurrency and NFT support, requiring no setup. Ballet aims to bring true global adoption to Bitcoin and cryptocurrency, by making it easy, safe, and reliable, for everyday people to store and manage their digital assets. Previously, Mr. Lee was the Co-founder and CEO of BTCC (also known as BTCChina), the first bitcoin exchange to launch in China, in 2011. The company was subsequently acquired in early 2018 by an investment firm in Hong Kong. Before BTCC, Mr. Lee was Vice President of Technology for Walmart's e-commerce business in China. Previously he was the CTO of SMG BesTV New Media, the largest IPTV operator in China with the most subscribers globally. He moved to Shanghai in 2007 and started off at EMC’s China Center of Excellence, as Director of Software Engineering, with responsibilities for Cloud Computing and Cloud Storage. Mr. Lee started his career in Silicon Valley as a software engineer at Yahoo!, and led the development of the earliest online communities. He graduated from Stanford University with B.S. and M.S. degrees in Computer Science, and was a member of the Mayfield Fellows Program. He earned an EMBA degree from CEIBS in China. In his spare time, he enjoys flying private planes, traveling, photography, watching movies, and playing poker.

name: Brian Quintenz
title: Board of Directors - Kalshi
bio: Brian D. Quintenz is a Board Chairman, Director, investor, and advisor to the world’s most innovative financial technology companies, including for KalshiEx, SUI Group Holdings (NASDAQ: SUIG), Next Level Derivatives, LLC, and Ubyx. He has long stood out as an innovative thinker in derivatives, blockchain and DeFi and was one of the earliest leaders in Washington to recognize the value of event contracts and crypto networks. Previously, Quintenz was the Global Head of Policy for a16z crypto, the crypto venture fund of Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), and a Commissioner of the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC), where he was unanimously confirmed by the U.S. Senate in 2017 and appointed by President Trump. Prior to his appointment to the CFTC, Quintenz worked in the financial markets, including at a Registered Investment Advisor and hedge fund he founded. He began his career on Capitol Hill in the House of Representatives as a legislative and policy advisor.

name: Cisco Aguilar
title: Secretary of State - Nevada
bio: Cisco Aguilar serves as Nevada’s Secretary of State. As Secretary, he is focused on modernizing, innovating and building transparency in the office. Under the Secretary’s leadership and vision, the office took on two major technology projects to modernize the state’s elections and business filings. The business filing system is making business easier in Nevada, and the statewide voter registration system, implemented in just fourteen months, increases security and streamlines the voter experience. Thanks to dedicated efforts to expand access to the ballot box, tribal voting turnout increased by 34% during the 2024 election. Prior to being elected, Secretary Aguilar served twelve years as General Counsel for Agassi Graf, the management company for Andre Agassi and Stefanie Graf, and the Andre Agassi Foundation for Education. In 2020, the Secretary launched Blueprint Sports, a sports technology startup, facilitating over $140 million in Name, Image, and Likeness (NIL) earnings for over 25,000 NCAA student-athletes since 2021. Secretary Aguilar is a graduate from the University of Arizona. Passionate about education, Secretary Aguilar is the Founding Chairman of Cristo Rey St. Viator High School, which provides an innovative workforce development program in one of Las Vegas’ most vulnerable neighborhoods. Secretary Aguilar also served on the Nevada Athletic Commission regulating boxing and mixed martial arts for eight years, two of which he served as Chairman.

name: Daniela Barbosa
title: Executive Director
bio: Daniela Barbosa serves as General Manager of Decentralized Technologies at the Linux Foundation and Executive Director of LF Decentralized Trust. She has overall strategic and operational responsibility for staff, programs, expansion, and execution of LF Decentralized Trust’s mission. Previously, she spent seven years in leadership roles at Hyperledger Foundation, driving the collaborative development of enterprise-grade blockchain and identity technologies by a global community. She is a leading voice for the power of openly developed decentralized technologies to optimize critical infrastructure for efficiency, privacy, and inclusivity.

name: Jamie King
title: CMO
bio: Jamie King is the Chief Marketing Officer of Minutes Network, a telecommunications and DePIN ecosystem that brings blockchain-powered infrastructure to one of the world's largest industries. His work spans the growth and adoption of Minutes Network's expanding ecosystem, including MNTx, the utility token powering network participation; Unetwork, a global mobile edge network; and Jingle, a developer platform that creates new revenue opportunities through telecommunications infrastructure. Jamie's focus is on helping scale real-world blockchain adoption through technologies that connect traditional telecom operators, mobile applications, network participants, and decentralized infrastructure. The ecosystem is designed to create tangible utility at a global scale, combining carrier-grade telecommunications with Web3-enabled participation models. While many know Jamie as a co-founder of Rockstar Games, where he helped build one of the most successful and influential companies in entertainment history and contributed to iconic franchises including Grand Theft Auto and Red Dead Redemption, his career has since spanned telecommunications, esports, media, technology, and Web3. A BAFTA Lifetime Achievement recipient, he has spent more than 30 years launching, scaling, and advising category-defining businesses across multiple industries, helping bring innovative technologies and products to global audiences.

name: Juan Leon
title: Senior Investment Strategist
bio: Juan Leon is the Senior Investment Strategist at Bitwise Asset Management where he helps lead research, product and strategy development, fund and index management, and supports sales and client relationships. Prior to Bitwise, he was a Portfolio Manager at U.S. Global Investors managing equity and fixed-income funds, and designed quantitative investment strategies. Before that, Juan was a Financial Analyst at Rackspace Technology where he contributed to financial planning and analysis. He is a graduate of Trinity University, double majoring in Political Science and Economics. Juan also earned the Chartered Financial Analyst designation from the CFA Institute.

name: Maggie Parsons
title: Head of Operations
bio: Maggie is Head of Operations at Lighter, a decentralized perps exchange using ZK technology to power high-performance trading on Ethereum. Her role covers finance, legal, compliance, and regulatory matters. Having spent her career across AI and crypto/fintech, she has a broad view of how emerging technology actually gets built and scaled. She’s drawn to the operational and structural challenges that come with building in new and complex spaces, of which DeFi has no shortage

name: Mary Beth Buchanan
title: Board of Directors
bio: Mary Beth Buchanan is a former U.S. Attorney for the Western District of Pennsylvania, serving from 2001 to 2009 after being appointed by President George W. Bush. She was the first woman and youngest person to hold that role, and also served in senior Department of Justice positions, including Acting Director of the Office on Violence Against Women. Following her government career, she has held leadership roles in law, finance, and crypto, including General Counsel at Kraken and executive positions at blockchain and fintech companies. She currently acts as Vice President on the Board of Directors of the Cardano Foundation.
program: Rare Evo 2026 (Main); Featured Exhibitors 2026; Dev/Gov Day

name: Micky Watkins
title: Founder & CEO
bio: Micky Watkins, CEO of World Mobile, is a telco entrepreneur. He raised millions in VC and private funding from heavyweights such as Deutsche Telekom and Carmel Ventures. As the Founder of Yallo, the first VOIP platform of its kind, Micky has spent the last decade developing business models to create how we connect.

name: Peter Gray
title: BD Manager
bio: Peter Gray is the BD Manager at Origin Protocol. Origin Protocol is a seasoned deceneralized finance protocol dating back to 2017, with the goal of enabling finance for all. Origin Protocol has launched a suite of unique yield products across multiple blockchains, designed in a set-and-forget fashion. Origin Protocol's OUSD is the world's first yield-bearing stablecoin, and the ARM enables users to take advantage of redeemable asset peg arbitrage.

name: Ron Hammond
title: Head of Policy & Advocacy
bio: Ron Hammond is the Head of Policy and Advocacy at Wintermute, a UK-based prop trading firm. Ron is leading Wintermute's US expansion in New York and brings nearly a decade of regulatory experience to his new role, having previously served as the Senior Director of Government Relations and Institutional Engagement at the Blockchain Association, a DC-based crypto trade association. His background also includes positions at Ripple as their in-house lobbyist and as Financial Services Policy Lead for Congressman Warren Davidson of Ohio, where he crafted the first bipartisan market structure bill known as the Token Taxonomy Act.

name: Sam Kazemian
title: Founder
bio: Founder of Frax Finance, a decentralized stablecoin cryptocurrency protocol. Previously, he co-founded Everipedia, a for-profit, wiki-based online encyclopedia. He founded Everipedia with Theodor Forselius in December 2014 and later served as its President. In 2019, he began development of Frax, a fractional stablecoin cryptocurrency.

name: Scott Dykstra
title: Co-Founder and CTO
bio: Scott Dykstra is Co-Founder and CTO of Space and Time. Scott previously served as a VP of Cloud at Teradata, where he spent nearly eight years bringing the firm from on-premise deployments to next-gen, cloud-based SaaS.

name: Stephen Gregory
title: CEO
bio: Stephen Gregory is CEO of Binance.US, leading the crypto exchange into its next phase of growth. Mr. Gregory has deep experience in building and scaling regulated crypto infrastructure companies, having previously served as U.S. CEO of Currency.com, a cryptocurrency trading platform and digital finance provider, through the company’s acquisition in 2025. A seasoned attorney with expertise in digital assets compliance, Mr. Gregory has also held key compliance leadership positions at Gemini and CEX.io. Mr. Gregory earned his J.D. from the Maurice A. Deane School of Law at Hofstra University. He also holds a B.A. in Political Science from Franklin & Marshall College, as well as an M.A. in Environmental Law and Policy from Vermont Law and Graduate School.

name: Sudhir Ravi
title: CEO
bio: Sudhir Ravi is a private equity executive and capital allocator with over 30 years of experience building and scaling businesses across technology, sports, and media. He serves as CEO of Chiliz US, where he is leading the US expansion of the world's leading Sports blockchain platform. A Board Member at the Kellogg School of Management and an Associate Professor at RIT's Saunders College of Business, Sudhir brings rare fluency across capital markets, innovation, and institutional leadership. He is based in Chicago.

name: Todd Ault
title: Executive Chairman & CEO
bio: Milton “Todd” Ault, III, is a visionary entrepreneur and seasoned business leader with over 34 years of experience in identifying and cultivating value across diverse financial markets. As the executive chairman and CEO of Ault & Company, a hybrid private equity firm with core operating platforms consisting of AI Data Centers, Infrastructure, Defense, and Capital Markets. Mr. Ault brings a wealth of knowledge and strategic insight to the forefront of business innovation.

name: Zane Huffman
title: CEO
bio: Zane Huffman, better known online as GREEN JEFF, is the co-founder and CEO of Odyssey Finance. Odyssey curates the entire onchain ecosystem into one unified interface, enabling a sophisticated superapp experience for trading, swapping, leveraging, automating, and earning yield.

name: Adam Rusch
title: Elected Member of Board of Directors

name: Adarsh Nair
title: Digital Assets, Banking & Capital Markets
bio: Adarsh is a member of EY’s Digital Assets Practice, working with financial institutions and fintech clients across digital assets, tokenization, stablecoins, custody, institutional DeFi and market structure initiatives. He has worked across both institutional and crypto native ecosystems, helping financial institutions evaluate strategic partnerships, build and investment decisions to accelerate digital asset capabilities and commercialization. Previously, Adarsh worked in strategy consulting, advising financial institutions on blockchain and crypto initiatives. Prior to that, Adarsh worked on the Digital Assets team at Goldman Sachs, supporting industry-first initiatives across Global Markets, Investment Banking, Asset Management and Wealth Management. Adarsh holds an MBA from Cornell University and a B.S. in Mathematics from UCLA.

name: Allen Dickerson
title: Partner
bio: Allen Dickerson is a partner in Baker & Hostetler LLP and a member of the firm’s Appellate and Political Law departments. His practice emphasizes First Amendment litigation, corporate political compliance counseling, and nonprofit advising. From 2020 to 2025, Dickerson served as a Senate-confirmed member of the Federal Election Commission. He chaired the Commission in 2022. During his tenure, he shepherded the first adoption of a new regulation in over a decade, led reforms to the Commission’s investigation and interagency practices, and authored more than 150 Statements of Reasons interpreting the Federal Election Campaign Act. Previously, he was Legal Director of the Institute for Free Speech, where he led a nationwide First Amendment practice. He has also worked as a litigation associate in the New York office of Kirkland & Ellis LLP. Dickerson is a Major in the Judge Advocate General’s Corps, U.S. Army Reserve, an Adjunct Professor at the University of Mississippi School of Law, and an Advisory Member of the American Bar Association’s Standing Committee on Election Law. He received his education at Yale College and New York University School of Law.

name: Ben Beckmann
title: Chief Technical Advisor
bio: Dr. Benjamin Beckmann is Chief Technical Adviser at the Midnight Foundation, advising on the development of the Midnight Network, a project he began supporting during his previous position at Input Output Global (IOG). Over the last 20 years, Ben's work has focused on incentives and evolutionary pressures to form communities and mold behavior, resulting in more than 30 refereed publications, 19 published patents, and over $14 million in federal funding. He is also an active contributor to multiple open-source software platforms, and his work has been the focus of articles in The New York Times, New Scientist, O'Reilly, and The Wall Street Journal. Ben holds a B.S., M.S., and Ph.D. in the field of Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence and has worked in the field of blockchain technology since 2014. His work has received multiple awards from General Electric and Frost & Sullivan. When he is not leading the technology vision for Midnight, Ben enjoys spending his free time with family and friends doing many hobbies, such as skiing, golfing, soccer, and cards.

name: Brian Kleven
title: CFO
bio: Brian serves as the Nevada Market Chief Financial Officer (CFO) of Dignity Health St. Rose Dominican Hospitals and manages the financial operations of all business entities in the organization. This includes the three acute care hospital locations, a medical group with approximately seventy-five providers, and several large-scale joint ventures in the Southern Nevada area. Over the course of his career, Brian has managed strategic acquisitions and successful system conversions at several hospitals. Brian has also managed revenue cycle operations at various hospitals and assisted in negotiating financially beneficial contracts with major insurance providers. Brian has a Master’s in Business Administration degree from the University of Nevada, Las Vegas and a Bachelor’s of Science degree with an emphasis in Finance from California State University, Northridge. He is a member of the Healthcare Finance Management Association (HFMA) and Financial Executives International (FEI). Brian serves on various community leadership boards in Nevada, including the Henderson Chamber of Commerce (HCC) Board of Directors, Las Vegas Global Economic Alliance (LVGEA) Board of Directors, Nevada Donor Network (NDN) Board of Directors, Opportunity Village (OV) Board of Directors, College of Southern Nevada (CSN) Foundation Board of Trustees, and Healthcare Financial Management Association (HFMA).

name: Carlos Souza
title: Co-Founder - Idopter Labs
bio: Carlos Souza is the co-founder and Director of R&D at Idopter Labs, where he leads software teams using Elixir. With a passion for blockchain technology, Carlos has become a prolific open-source contributor, particularly in the Cardano ecosystem. His notable projects include Xogmios, an Elixir client for Ogmios, and Xander, an Elixir network client implementation for the Cardano Ouroboros protocol. He is also the operator of the JUNGLE Cardano Stake Pool.

name: Chris johnson
title: Co-Founder
bio: Chris Johnson is a co-founder of Virtuals Protocol, a Web3 platform focused on creating and monetizing AI-powered virtual agents. With a background in digital marketing and virtual reality, he has played a key role in building and growing the project’s ecosystem, contributing across product, community, and business development.

name: Daniel Kang
title: CSO
bio: DK is Chief Strategy Officer of DeFi Development Corp (NASDAQ: DFDV): the best performing crypto stock of 2025. Prior to DFDV, DK was Head of Strategy at Kraken Crypto Exchange. He also spent 8 years in Long/Short Equity covering Internet and Media as a senior analyst at AO Asset Management, a $1B hedge fund. DK’s prior experience includes Corporate Development and Strategy at Snap, as well as Credit Risk Management at Morgan Stanley.

name: Danielle Casey
title: President & CEO
bio: Ms. Casey brings extensive and diverse experience in leadership, public administration, marketing, business development and retention, and strategic planning as the leader of AREA, a nonprofit organization working to create a prosperous and diverse economy for the four-county Albuquerque metro region. She joined the organization in October of 2020. Since her arrival, she has transitioned the organization with the delivery of a new Strategic Plan, achieved the status of Accredited Economic Development Organization, engaged formally with regional community partners, renamed and restructured its bylaws and nonprofit status to a 501c3 public charity, and received numerous recognition awards - specifically in 2024 the Bronze Award for Economic Development Organization of the Year from the International Economic Development Council. Previously, she served as the Executive Vice President for the Greater Sacramento Economic Council and oversaw the organization's business development, marketing and communications, investor engagement, research, and strategic initiatives critical to advancing economic growth in Greater Sacramento. She oversaw the comprehensive launch and execution of a best-in class national site selection consultant strategy and established first-ever memorandums of understanding with seven local commercial real estate brokerage offices, receiving a Gold Award from the International Economic Development Council in 2020 for a joint publication she spearheaded with CBRE. She established critical internal efficiencies with revisions to all organizational practices from database management to budget development and oversight. Even in the wake of COVID-19, the organization succeeded in meeting all its annual metrics and job creation goals and launching a regional business retention and expansion outreach program.

name: David Buttrey
title: Co-Founder & President
bio: Executive with global reach having Generated $250M+ in economic value through strategic partnerships across multiple cross-cultural settings in India, Canada, USA, South Africa, the Middle East, and Europe, managing diverse demographics.

name: Debbie Soon
title: Head of Marketing
bio: Debbie Soon is a Singaporean entrepreneur, investor, and marketing leader, currently Head of Marketing at Privy, a crypto infrastructure company helping bring users onchain. She is the author of Digital Mavericks, a guide to Web3 and blockchain innovation, and a two-time founder, including HUG, a creator-focused platform acquired by .ART. With a background spanning finance, tech, and consumer businesses, she’s known for bridging technology, creativity, and community in the Web3 space.

name: Eleanor Terrett
title: Co-Founder & Co-Host
bio: Eleanor Terrett is an award-winning journalist and co-founder of the Crypto In America podcast and newsletter. Over the past two years, she has become one of the most trusted sources for breaking news on crypto policy and regulation in Washington. Prior to launching her independent media platform, she spent nine years at FOX Business, including four years covering crypto policy alongside veteran financial journalist and author Charles Gasparino.

name: Erin Gambrel
title: Founder
bio: Erin Gambrel, known as The Blonde Broker, is a crypto entrepreneur, investor, and media personality with over 8 years of experience in digital assets. As the founder of Proof of Sweat, she is building the future of fitness by turning physical performance into an economy—where users earn rewards, compete, and create real value through discipline. Erin bridges the gap between macro markets, crypto infrastructure, and consumer applications through her podcast The Market Runup, the fastest growing emerging macro and tech show.

name: Igor Bershadsky
title: Chief Growth Officer
bio: Web3 entrepreneur with 15+ years of experience spanning financial product sales, project management, and FinTech innovation. My career began in traditional finance, where I spent 13 years building commercial and operational expertise before transitioning into cybersecurity and blockchain. Igor serves as Chief Growth Officer at Hacken, where he works on blockchain security challenges and strategic growth initiatives, supporting the development of robust and secure Web3 ecosystems. His focus lies in bridging traditional finance with decentralized technologies, driving adoption, and scaling secure blockchain solutions.

name: Ivan Kan
title: CMO
bio: Ivan Kan is the CMO of T7X, an SEC-registered transfer agent on a mission to rebuild capital markets from the ground up. T7X is rewriting the rules of securities issuance. Built on compliance-first blockchain infrastructure, T7X is one of the only platforms in the world where tokenization happens at the moment of issuance. The token is not a wrapper. It is not a proof of ownership. It is the security itself. No intermediaries. No receipts. No synthetic exposure. Just direct, programmable ownership of real assets, issued inside U.S. securities law from day one. Where legacy markets restricted access to capital formation behind layers of gatekeepers, T7X tears that down. Investors get 24/7 liquidity. Issuers get a direct line to capital. And every transaction settles on-chain, transparently, in real time. Capital Markets. Rebuilt. A Forbes contributor, Ivan writes on market structure, the future of ownership, and the infrastructure decisions that will determine whether tokenization delivers on its promise or repeats the same failures with better branding. Beyond his operating role, Ivan is a global entrepreneur with one successful exit and an active portfolio as an investor and board member across disruptive technology companies and early-stage ventures.

name: Jake Salerno
title: VP of GTM
bio: Jake leads Business Development at Zero Gravity Labs, where he built and oversees the team responsible for driving ecosystem integrations and strategic go-to-market execution. Since mid-2024, he has built and led a high-impact BD team while directly managing Tier 1 operational partners across the most critical verticals. Under his leadership, 0G has secured over 350 integrations across its modular decentralized AI infrastructure stack. Jake works closely with stakeholders across the 60+ person team, including product, legal, engineering, and marketing, to shape ecosystem strategy, accelerate adoption, and align 0G’s core infrastructure with the needs of its most strategic partners. Prior to 0G, he spent three years at Chainlink Labs leading go-to-market for data products, contributing to over $1 trillion in Total Value Secured through product adoption. A founder with nearly a decade in crypto, Jake has built and exited multiple startups and remains an active contributor to the broader Web3 and AI ecosystems.

name: James Delmore
title: Blockchain & Crypto Analyst
bio: James Delmore is a Blockchain and Crypto Market Analyst at Breadcrumbs, where he conducts on-chain investigations and produces investigative reports that have been covered by CNBC, Fox Business and others. James also held analyst roles at Figment, Chorus One, and Solidus Labs, covering everything from the staking market to digital asset regulatory analysis. Prior to working in the crypto industry, he was a Researcher at Fox News from 2016 to 2021. James holds an M.A. in Communication from Tel Aviv University and is based in New York and Miami.

name: Jeremy Berrington (JB)
title: CEO
bio: Jeremy Berrington is the CEO of SCRIB3, a creative and communications agency focused on frontier technologies, including cryptocurrency, artificial intelligence, and cybersecurity. With more than 20 years of experience helping businesses and governments navigate technological change, Jeremy has advised governments around the world, including Mexico, Canada, the United Arab Emirates, and Bahrain. He has held senior leadership roles at global agencies such as Publicis Groupe and Real Chemistry, and previously served as Press Secretary to Illinois Governor Rod Blagojevich.

name: Joey Ingram
title: Pro Poker Player
bio: Joe Ingram, also known as ‘Chicago Joey’ or ‘BigPapi’, is a multifaceted poker personality known for his impactful presence in the poker media landscape. Ingram’s journey into poker began with a keen interest in competitive gaming. He transitioned to poker during his college years, initially dabbling in micro-stakes online. His strategic acumen and relentless work ethic would soon propel him to higher stakes, where he achieved further success and recognition. Beyond his achievements as a player, Ingram is widely acknowledged for his contributions to the poker community through various media platforms. His podcast, ‘ The Joe Ingram Poker Life Podcast’, became a staple for poker enthusiasts, featuring in-depth interviews with top players, industry experts and personalities.

name: John Medel
title: Head of Public Policy
bio: John Medel oversees policy and regulatory engagement at the Injective Policy Institute, where he promotes responsible innovation across the digital assets space, including tokenization, RWAs, and on-chain lending. Prior to this, he was part of Coinbase’s Public Policy team, where he focused on international regulations and led market entry efforts in India, Turkey, Brazil, and Canada. He also served as a Vice President in Government Affairs at Goldman Sachs, specializing in the post-Dodd-Frank regulatory environment and cross-border investments and acquisitions. Mr. Medel holds master’s degrees from London School of Economics in International Political Economy and Georgetown University in American Government and National Security Studies.

name: JT Benavides
title: CEO
bio: JT Benavides, CEO of Ravariant Labs. Ravariant builds the underwriting, risk, and smart contract infrastructure for NAV lending against private fund collateral. Previously underwrote and deployed over $200M against illiquid assets.

name: Kevin Jones
title: Senior Developer Relations Engineer
bio: Kevin Jones, Senior Developer Relations Engineer at Edge & Node with over 7 years of experience supporting the Ethereum developer community and The Graph ecosystem. Kevin is currently focused on supporting both ampersend for agentic payments and Amp which gives regulated banks, stablecoin issuers, and large enterprises the structured, auditable blockchain data infrastructure they need to operate at scale and stay compliant.

name: Lloyd Nelson
title: SVP & Head of U.S. Digital Assets
bio: After 15 years launching and scaling tech startups, Lloyd Nelson saw insurance not as a legacy constraint, but as crypto’s missing infrastructure layer. As SVP and Head of U.S. Digital Assets at Howden, he works with leading crypto, fintech, and technology firms to bring risk transfer on-chain, building the trust layer needed for institutional capital to enter digital assets.

name: Lukas Seel
title: Ecosystem Lead
bio: Lukas Seel is Ecosystem Lead at MultiversX, where he runs builder programs and ecosystem initiatives. He has founded multiple companies, brought thousands of non-crypto users onchain before utility-first was the norm, and advises early-stage startups. These days he runs experiments at the edge of what autonomous machines are capable of both onchain and off.

name: Margie Feng
title: Head of Marketing
bio: Margie Feng leads marketing at Solayer, where she is currently focused on Solayer Pay. With a background spanning crypto and global brand building, she specializes in translating complex technical products into clear, compelling narratives that resonate with users. Previously at FuzzLand and BITMAIN, Margie led high-impact campaigns, global events, and influencer programs, helping build strong ecosystems across Web3.

name: Mark Ghatan
title: Senior Wealth Strategist
bio: Mark Ghatan is a Senior Wealth Strategist at Bespoke Group, an advisory firm serving high-net-worth individuals and families with complex, non-traditional wealth. He is a trust and estate attorney specializing in advanced planning for digital assets, closely held businesses, and multi-jurisdictional structures, advising on trust and ownership frameworks that balance control, continuity, tax efficiency, and long-term stewardship. With a background in complex investigations and security consulting, Mark takes a security-first approach to structuring wealth, helping clients, particularly those with concentrated crypto holdings, navigate risks around custody, jurisdiction, and personal safety.

name: Mason Lynaugh
title: Executive Director
bio: Mason Lynaugh is a crypto policy and community leader, currently serving as Executive Director of Stand With Crypto, a major U.S. advocacy organization for digital assets. He was the group’s first hire and previously led its grassroots and community efforts, helping grow it to millions of advocates nationwide. Lynaugh is also a co-founder of ATX DAO and was recognized on Forbes’ 30 Under 30 Austin for his work advancing Web3 adoption and policy engagement.

name: Michael Terpin
title: CEO - Transform Ventures
bio: One of the earliest thought leaders and influencers in the bitcoin/crypto world, Michael Terpin was pronounced the “Godfather of Crypto” by CNBC for his advisory and marketing efforts for many prominent early projects in crypto, including the launches of Ethereum and Tether.

name: Navin Vethanayagam
title: Chief Brain and Co-Founder
bio: Chief Brain of IQ and Co-founder of KRWQ. He has led IQ since 2022 with the mission of building a more intelligent financial system with global stablecoin infrastructure, autonomous AI agents, and the world’s largest blockchain encyclopedia. He spearheaded the launch of KRWQ, the first ever Korean won stablecoin.

name: Nikhilesh De
title: Managing Editor, Global Policy & Regulation
bio: Nikhilesh De is CoinDesk's managing editor for global policy and regulation, covering regulators, lawmakers and institutions. He authors CoinDesk's State of Crypto newsletter, won a Gerald Loeb award in the beat reporting category as part of CoinDesk's blockbuster FTX coverage in 2023, and was named the Association of Cryptocurrency Journalists and Researchers' Journalist of the Year in 2020.

name: Nitin Gaur
title: Head of Institutions
bio: Nitin Gaur is Head of Institutions at Nethermind, where he works with financial institutions to modernize market infrastructure through production-grade blockchain and systems engineering. He is also a Senior Advisor to DTCC Digital Asset, contributing to the evolution of post-trade, custody, and settlement frameworks for tokenized markets. Previously, Nitin served as Managing Director at State Street and founded IBM Digital Asset Labs, IBM Blockchain Labs, and LedgerLink—an AI-powered platform bridging traditional finance and decentralized systems. He is an IBM Distinguished Engineer and Master Inventor, with deep experience across digital assets, payments, and financial infrastructure.

name: Oliver Maroney
title: Head of Business Development and Partnerships
bio: Oliver Maroney leads Business Development and Partnerships at OpenSea. Based out of Portland, Oregon, Oliver’s previous experience includes managing esports and sports talent, sports reporting and more. At OpenSea, Oliver has forged partnerships with some of the best games in the space and started OpenSea’s gaming initiatives like OpenseaGG, a way for web3 enabled games to showcase their games with educational streams and content

name: Pi Lanningham
title: CTO
bio: Self professed mathematician by passion, programmer by trade, Pi Lanningham has spent the last 4 years working to push Cardano to its peak potential through advocacy, education, advice, consulting, and open source development.

name: Porter Stowell
title: CEO
bio: Porter Stowell is discoverer of the non-obvious who inspires and unites the brave and the bold to be the pioneers of our digital future. For Porter, there is no better place to pursue this passion than in Web3. It’s an addiction! Porter started his blockchain journey back in 2017 with IBM Blockchain. As a product manager, Porter spent five years working with large enterprises on their blockchain future, leaving as the Head of Product Management. Diving deeper into web3, Porter went on to become the Director of Customer Advocacy at Coinbase where he created engagement approaches for six web3 product lines to ensure global support and scalability. From there, Porter was the Head of Ecosystem and Community for the Filecoin Foundation where he orchestrated the engagement of over 3,000 storage providers, software builders, service providers, investors, and other ecosystem enablers to support the advancement of the Filecoin network and decentralized storage. Today, Porter is the CEO of W3.io; W3 is the operating system for autonomous finance that enables both agents and humans to create any financial workflows for any use case, with any vendor combination. Humans operate at the strategic level, while the platform handles workflow execution, settlement, and management all via a single pane of glass. W3 is driving Web3 adoption beyond the crypto ecochamber solving real problems for real businesses.

name: Sam Green
title: Founder
bio: Sam Green is the founder of Cambrian Network, the financial intelligence layer for agents and institutions. Before Cambrian, Sam co-founded and served as CTO at Semiotic Labs, leading AI and verifiability efforts for The Graph. Sam also helped develop Odos, a leading crypto trading platform that has handled $100 billion in trading volume for 3 million users. Previously, Sam was an AI and cryptography researcher at Sandia National Labs. Sam holds a master's degree in applied mathematics and earned a Ph.D. in computer science at UC Santa Barbara.

name: Tamara Szulc
title: Community Coordinator
bio: Tamara Szulc is the Community Coordinator at Stand With Crypto, where she leads grassroots organizing efforts to advance pro-crypto legislation. She brings a diverse background spanning Web3 venture capital, law firms, and legal consulting, along with a J.D. from Emory University School of Law, where she focused on intellectual property and emerging technology. Tamara combines legal expertise with a deep understanding of decentralized innovation to drive meaningful, community-led change in the future of crypto and Web3 policy.

name: Ubair Javaid
title: Co-Founder & CEO
bio: Ubair Javaid is a digital asset, digital ledger technology (DLT), and tokenization expert with a track record of creating innovative digital asset management solutions. As the CEO of Nomyx, he leads a team that is pioneering the democratization of asset tokenization across multiple industries. He has extensive experience in blockchain architecture, compliance for IoT, and data-driven billing platforms for commercial airliners. He previously led developmental efforts for Panasonic Avionics, where he developed solutions that integrated data analytics with Salesforce to optimize complex SLA-driven billing environments. His current focus is on delivering cutting-edge blockchain products that solve critical enterprise challenges.
